summary: First-iteration E2E test of Crystal Makeover Salon & Academy. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass covering catalog, OTP auth, admin auth+role guard, availability, gender policy, double-booking prevention, mock payment, price snapshot immutability, review flow (only after COMPLETED, no duplicates), admin dashboard KPIs+7-day trend, admin CRUD, settings, remaining-payment, cancellation, cross-customer access forbidden, and SMS log persistence (BOOKING_CONFIRMATION + SERVICE_COMPLETED). Frontend: Home renders 7 categories + 6 featured, Services page renders, OTP login flow with dev_otp shown works, booking wizard completes end-to-end (service → date → slot → details → mock pay → /booking/success/:id), Admin login + all sidebar pages navigate. Fixed one runtime bug in admin pages: `useEffect(load, [])` was returning a Promise (React thought it was a cleanup fn, giving PAGEERROR: 'destroy is not a function' in AdminReviews and warnings in Dashboard/AdminServices/AdminBookings). Wrapped calls in arrow fn.

minor.issue: booking_id passed as query param instead of JSON body — works but atypical REST style
Uses untyped Dict[str,Any] body instead of Pydantic model (no validation)
Server uses naive UTC (`now_utc().replace(tzinfo=None)`) for past-slot filtering; may mismatch actual salon local time in production (IST)

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(load, []) returned a Promise → 'destroy is not a function' PAGEERROR crashed AdminReviews. Fixed by wrapping in arrow function.

issues: 'Engagement Look' Unsplash image (photo-1595872018818-97555653a011) resolves to an unrelated 'Drop your images here or browse' file-uploader UI screenshot — replace with a real bridal engagement photo
Recharts warns 'width(-1) height(-1)' repeatedly — ResponsiveContainer parent likely lacks explicit height on initial render; consider aspect ratio or fixed height

action_items: Replace the 'Engagement Look' service image URL — current Unsplash id renders a file-uploader screenshot, not bridal imagery.
Add explicit height (or aspect) to Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrappers on AdminDashboard to eliminate width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
Consider migrating the endpoint POST /api/payments/create-order to accept booking_id in JSON body for consistency.
Consider timezone-awareness for availability: current past-slot cutoff assumes UTC server time equals salon local time.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1089 lines — split into modules (auth, catalog, bookings, payments, admin, sms) for maintainability.
In-memory OTP has no rate-limit on request-otp (only 5-attempt guard on verify) — production risk once real SMS is wired.
Payment 'verify' currently trusts any signature (fine for mock) but the comment must be enforced with HMAC when RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET is present.
Race window between compute_slots and insert_one in _create_booking_doc is mitigated with an $expr conflict check — good; add a unique compound index or transactional upsert for stronger guarantees.
AdminReviews PATCH accepts arbitrary Dict; add Pydantic model to prevent field injection.
Frontend anti-pattern `useEffect(load, [])` (Promise-returning fn) was present in 4 pages — audit remaining `useEffect(<fn>, [])` usages.

Runs against public URL from frontend/.env. All 21 pass. Playwright verified home/login/booking/admin. If retesting focuses on image fixes or Recharts sizing, only frontend smoke-check needed.
rca of the issue: AdminReviews crashed on navigation because useEffect(load, []) passed a Promise-returning function. React destructures the return value expecting either undefined or a cleanup fn; a Promise is neither, causing 'destroy is not a function' when unmounting. Fixed by wrapping load() inside a synchronous arrow function so useEffect gets an undefined return. Same anti-pattern found and fixed in Dashboard, AdminServices, and AdminBookings.
